content: Table-to-text generation is an important and challenging task in natural language processing, which aims to produce the summarization of numerical table BIBREF0, BIBREF1. The related methods can be empirically divided into two categories, pipeline model and end-to-end model. The former consists of content selection, document planning and realisation, mainly for early industrial applications, such as weather forecasting and medical monitoring, etc. The latter generates text directly from the table through a standard neural encoder-decoder framework to avoid error propagation and has achieved remarkable progress. In this paper, we particularly focus on exploring how to improve the performance of neural methods on table-to-text generation.
